versions.subject: Redcannary windows
versions.detection:
selection_cmd:
    ScriptBlockText|contains|all: 
        - Copy-Item
        - '-Destination'
selection_path:
    ScriptBlockText|contains: '\Opera Software\Opera Stable\Login Data'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ScriptBlockText="*Copy-Item*" ScriptBlockText="*-Destination*" ScriptBlockText="*\\Opera Software\\Opera Stable\\Login Data*"

versions.subject: Add other browser
versions.detection:
selection_cmd:
    ScriptBlockText|contains|all: 
        - Copy-Item
        - '-Destination'
selection_path:
    ScriptBlockText|contains: 
        - '\Opera Software\Opera Stable\Login Data'
        - '\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles'
        - '\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\Default'
        - '\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Login Data'
        - '\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Login Data For Account'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ScriptBlockText="*Copy-Item*" ScriptBlockText="*-Destination*" ScriptBlockText IN ("*\\Opera Software\\Opera Stable\\Login Data*", "*\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles*", "*\\Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data\\Default*", "*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\Default\\Login Data*", "*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\Default\\Login Data For Account*")
